channel.title: Three Clues: A History Mystery Minute
channel.description:
Short history puzzles. You hear three clues, each one more specific, then you get a moment to guess before the answer. Good for car rides, classrooms and trivia lovers.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of PastRush: History Detective, an iPhone history game where you solve real moments from the past with clues. PastRush: History Detective on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
